'''Velmin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] she was stationed in the [[Dorn Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where she managed armor and equipment.
